title: Published my first game on Steam...and my dog has no idea he's the hero...
author: cybr1dtech
selftext:
Hey, sharing my game here since this is one of the few places it won't immediately get pitchforks. Figured I'd start with a PC publish first, then work on porting it to iOS/Android.

**Cyberpunk Neon Survivor.** Top-down bullet hell roguelike, Godot 4, launched on Steam last week. Solo dev under Bacondog Game Studio. The protagonist is my actual dog Dunkin (A Lab/Beagle/Boxer mix). There is bacon. I like bacon...There is also a limited-time  Start Spangled Armored (Patriot Dunkin) that unlocks July 1st - July 31st.

Production was mixed. Claude Code did a lot of the GDScript heavy lifting and most of the Steam release pipeline. Some Grok for the Cyberpunk arena & characters creation. Gemini took a picture of me and my dog both sticking our head out of the window to turn it into the logo and intro video LOL. Some In-game graphics are from [itch.io](http://itch.io) art packs (credited), some AI-assisted sprites and icons in the mix. Music is from pixabay, credited by name (though I think a couple of the tracks are AI generated too).

Anyway, figured this sub would actually be interested rather than just mad. Happy to talk about the workflow if anyone's curious.

https://reddit.com/link/1tmysa0/video/fpl9mqnos73h1/player

replies.author: cybr1dtech
replies.body:
Probably not as unique as I'd like, if I'm being honest. Truly unique games are rare  (and I personally have a high bar to grade something unique)...FWIW...most of us are remixing a formula of some sort with a bit of our personality and soul (in my case, I love my dog, and I love bacon)...but I can't really pretend I've created something truly unique.

It's a survivor, bones are pretty Vampire-Survivors-shaped. My spin: mech-dogs vs cybernetic cats vs squirrel swarms...and Bacon.

Mostly though, I woke up one morning and thought to myself that there's a distinct shortage of dogs, cats and squirrels fighting it out in a cyberpunk world. Felt like I had to do something about it LOL

I just uploaded a demo of it on [itch.io](http://itch.io) which allows the first 10 levels to be fully playable. I'm not sure if I'm allowed to post the itch link, but just search for "cyberpunkneonsurvivordemo". I just uploaded it about 20 minutes ago so it might not be indexed yet for the search, however happy to send you the direct URL if you'd like to try it out (or if it's OK to post the link here)

replies.author: blightor
replies.body:
"Mostly though, I woke up one morning and thought to myself that there's a distinct shortage of dogs, cats and squirrels fighting it out in a cyberpunk world."

Lol.  That's certainly true!!

What a great feeling of accomplishment it must be for you.  I mean even with AI its not easy to finish up with a reasonable first effort like this.  The biggest issue with AI, is that its soullessly unoriginal, and actively squirts you down well trodden paths (IMO if you are not constantly arguing with your AI, then you are not using it right!) - overcome that and that's when you can really do well!
